summary: Fire tower listed under the Georgia Forestry Commission in Jasper County, northwest of Monticello; no source found on its build date or current state.

evidence.supports: Listed under Georgia Forestry Commission for Jasper County
evidence.quote: MONTICELLO Jasper County - Georgia Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: tnlandforms list: Monticello Lookout Tower, Jasper County, codes BLL-41100 and gfc-605, coordinates 33.31901, -83.72434 (the row also has an elevation figure, 627, with no unit stated; not used)
The tnlandforms list was revised on 22 March 2016
GFC county contact page gives the Jasper County location as a firetower on Hwy 212, northwest of Monticello
evidence.quote: Firetower on Hwy 212, Northwest of Monticello

evidence.supports: GFC began phasing out tower operators in the late 1980s for an air patrol system; many towers were scrapped and sold
evidence.quote: In the late 1980s, the Georgia Forestry Commission began phasing out the tower operators in favor of an air patrol system. Many were scrapped and sold

notes_for_editor: Thin sources. The tnlandforms list (cite 1) and the Eastern US Lookouts directory (cite 2) give only name, county, elevation and codes (cite 1) and the agency (cite 2); neither gives a build date, design, status or access. The GFC county contact page (cite 3) gives Jasper County's location as a firetower on Hwy 212, but its layout is jumbled, so the Firetower Road address rows could not be matched to Jasper with certainty and were not used. Web search leads not used because no page read tied them to this tower: a 2024 US Topo map label and a 2006 auction note. A cached newspaper article about a 'Monticello' fire tower (data/raw/web/3d8a8decf766fdff51e63ede2815d24a82369f48.bin) is about Monticello, Florida (Jefferson County, Florida Division of Forestry) and was excluded. Jasper Lookout Tower (GA028, 33.39707,-83.77101) is a different Jasper County tower and was not used. Status, access and build date need a human check, for example a GFC Jasper County enquiry or recent imagery at 33.31901,-83.72434. No corrections proposed; record fields match the tnlandforms list. Verification 2026-10-21: the story's elevation (627 ft, 191 m) was removed because the list gives no unit; the phase-out sentence was reworded from the source's wording.
